title: The Resume Paradox: Greater Language Differences, Smaller Pay Gaps

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing language differences between male and female resumes using Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) and rank-turbulence divergence (RTD), measuring the semantic similarity of male and female resume descriptions to canonical job activities (O*NET DWAs) using SBERT, and evaluating word-level gender associations using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT).
